entries.en: Johnny Silverhand sends his regards.
Alt? You here?!
We got this.
Smasher!
Pathetic meat.
Break free!
Are you fucking with me now?
entries.ro: Acum chiar mă iei la mișto, pula mea?

entries.en: C'mon, not much further to go.
We saw this place in a dream.
entries.ro: Am văzut locul ăsta într-un vis.

entries.en: Don't know how... but it worked.
entries.ro: Nu știu cum... dar a mers.

entries.en: Find the access point in the center of the room. You must connect to it.
entries.ro: Caută punctul de acces din mijlocul camerei. Trebuie să te conectezi la el.

entries.en: See ya on the other side.
Damn, just took down Silverhand's nemesis…
entries.ro: Naiba, tocmai am doborât nemesis-ul lui Silverhand…

entries.en: Here to save my own skin.
Took down Johnny's arch-enemy. Gotten good, I guess – damn, it feels nice.
entries.ro: L-am doborât pe arhi-dușmanul lui Johnny. Mă descurc binișor, cred – naiba, ce bine se simte.

entries.en: Couple of fossils actin' like snot-nosed brats, you two.
entries.ro: Două fosile care se poartă ca niște pici mofturoși, voi doi.

entries.en: Hurry to Mikoshi before they launch another attack.
entries.ro: Mișcă la Mikoshi, înainte să mai dea un atac.

entries.en: Then submerse yourself in coolant.
entries.ro: Apoi scufundă-te în lichidul de răcire.

entries.en: What's with the door?
Don't strain yourself, now.
He's got a point, V. Shut up and finish him, be done with it.
entries.ro: Are dreptate, V. Taci din gură și termină-l odată, hai.

entries.en: Regards from Johnny.
I'm here for me. For my life.
entries.ro: Sunt aici pentru mine. Pentru viața mea.

entries.en: I will be waiting.
[Jack in] It worked...
[Jack in]
